items.question: What terminal limits define the third and fourth divisions in the prescribed hall measurements?
premises: The third division extends up to the bodhikā.
The fourth division extends up to the uttarā.
These limits specify the prescribed structural measurements.
items.inference: The third and fourth divisions are distinguished by their respective terminal points at the bodhikā and the uttarā.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referents of bodhikā and uttarā in this context are not fully specified.
items.plain_english: The third extends up to the bodhikā, and the fourth extends up to the uttarā.
